facts.fact: ANEC's director general said at Mbacké on 16 February 2026 that the Logiciel de gestion de l'état civil (LGEC), which a centre must install before it can have the online request platform, constitutes the central database; the document does not say when or by whom acts are entered into it.
facts.system: Logiciel de gestion de l'état civil (LGEC)

facts.fact: The Agence nationale de l'état civil (ANEC) sets the LGEC as the software any civil-status centre must install, per its director general on 16 February 2026.
facts.system: Logiciel de gestion de l'état civil (LGEC)

systems.system: Logiciel de gestion de l'état civil (LGEC)
systems.tiers: civil-status centres; described as the central database
online requests for birth, death and marriage acts, delivered to phone or computer; four-week test in five pilot communes including Mbacké from 16 February 2026
